# B2B Operations & FinOps Benchmarks

> Open, reproducible benchmarks for AI infrastructure, contractor closeouts, and wholesale catalogs, with interactive tools for food labels, image edits, automation planning, and AI video camera control.

Benchmark rates are illustrative USD inputs. The HTML reference includes the formulas, inputs and benchmark results. The browser calculators use the same fixtures and process inputs locally.

## Benchmarks

- [AI infrastructure cost](https://shihaowei49-cloud.github.io/b2b-ops-finops-benchmarks/#finops): $18.30/month for sample LLM tokens, $330 for voice sessions, $526.56 for agent retries, and $54.60 for generation plus RAG overhead.
- [Contractor closeout](https://shihaowei49-cloud.github.io/b2b-ops-finops-benchmarks/#closeout): Match work-order line IDs across a Before/After PDF and open-items CSV, normalize EXIF orientation, and compare capture times on a shared time basis. Seven photos at four per page take two pages.
- [Apparel wholesale](https://shihaowei49-cloud.github.io/b2b-ops-finops-benchmarks/#wholesale): Round a 25-unit MOQ in packs of six to 30 units, check the GS1 GTIN digit, and validate Shopify product handle and variant options.

## Interactive tools

- [NutritionLabelPack](https://nutritionlabel.shihaoeth.site/): U.S. Nutrition Facts panel builder with five layout options, UPC-A, and vector PDF and SVG exports.
- [FDA Nutrition Facts generator](https://nutritionlabel.shihaoeth.site/tools/fda-nutrition-facts-generator): Checks measured per-serving declarations against rounding thresholds.
- [Dual-column Nutrition Facts maker](https://nutritionlabel.shihaoeth.site/tools/dual-column-nutrition-label-maker): Displays serving and package declarations side by side.
- [SameFontPack](https://samefont.shihaoeth.site/): Browser-native raster text replacement with background sampling, font and baseline controls, and a SHA-256 export digest.
- [Webfont fallback CSS generator](https://samefont.shihaoeth.site/tools/webfont-cls-zero-layout-shift-fallback-generator): Derives size-adjust and vertical metric overrides for a font stack.
- [AIROIPack](https://airoipack.shihaoeth.site/): B2B automation ROI, three-scenario sensitivity, payback, and 12-month cash-flow proposals.
- [AI agent payback calculator](https://airoipack.shihaoeth.site/tools/ai-agent-payback-period-calculator): Models when cumulative cash flows recover implementation costs.
- [Payback, NPV, and sensitivity guide](https://airoipack.shihaoeth.site/ai-payback-period-npv-and-sensitivity-analysis-guide): Explains how to compare discounted cash flows and scenario assumptions.
- [MAI Voice Budget](https://maivoice.shihaoeth.site/): MAI speech pipeline cost and GitHub Copilot code review organization billing models.
- [BudgetHub](https://budgethub.shihaoeth.site/): Homepage AI budgets and cached-token estimates.
- [AI Token Cost Calculator](https://budgethub.shihaoeth.site/tools/ai-token-cost-calculator): Standard input, cached input, and output charges.
- [RAG and vector database worksheet](https://budgethub.shihaoeth.site/tools/rag-vector-db-tco-calculator): Estimates the monthly retrieval stack cost.
- [CloseoutPack](https://closeout.shihaoeth.site/): Before/After photo handover PDFs and open-items CSVs.
- [Move-out inspection checklist](https://closeout.shihaoeth.site/tools/move-out-inspection-checklist): Room-by-room condition records.
- [Construction change order template](https://closeout.shihaoeth.site/tools/construction-change-order-template): Scope, cost, and schedule change records.
- [Construction submittal log](https://closeout.shihaoeth.site/tools/construction-submittal-log-template): Revision and approval tracking.
- [Certificate of insurance checklist](https://closeout.shihaoeth.site/tools/certificate-of-insurance-coi-closeout-checklist): Records coverage and supporting evidence for project handover.
- [LineSheetPack](https://linesheet.shihaoeth.site/): Buyer-specific wholesale line sheets and order forms.
- [Wholesale packing slip template](https://linesheet.shihaoeth.site/tools/wholesale-packing-slip-template): Shipped quantities by SKU and purchase order.
- [Product spec sheet template](https://linesheet.shihaoeth.site/tools/product-spec-sheet-template): Dimensions, materials, and variant specifications.
- [Wholesale size-run order form](https://linesheet.shihaoeth.site/tools/wholesale-size-run-order-form): Order quantities by size.
- [Fashion lookbook and line sheet builder](https://linesheet.shihaoeth.site/tools/fashion-lookbook-vs-line-sheet-builder): Prepares a visual assortment and buyer-facing SKU list.
- Recalculates KDP paperback spine width, compares old and new fold guides, and previews a full-wrap PDF repair. [SpineRetrofit](https://spineretrofit.shihaoeth.site/)
- Checks SRT and WebVTT cues for timing, reading speed, and line length, then reconciles subtitle tracks against a CSV manifest. [SubPackQC](https://subpackqc.shihaoeth.site/)
- Builds four-page wedding newspapers with text and photo checks, an 11 × 17 in duplex PDF, and a print-shop fold test. [WedPaperPack](https://wedpaper.shihaoeth.site/)

## Catering, bookkeeping, and rent

- Generates banquet event order PDFs for the client and kitchen, plus a revision diff. Event Pass, $15 once or $12 with LAUNCH20. [BEOPack](https://beopack.shihaoeth.site/)
- Reconciles bank statement PDFs to the cent and exports QuickBooks CSV and XLSX. 50-Page Pass, $19 once or $15.20 with LAUNCH20. [StatementPack](https://statementpack.shihaoeth.site/)
- Exports tenant rent ledger PDF and CSV statements with partial payments, late fees, and running balances. 5-Unit Pass, $9 once or $7.20 with LAUNCH20. [RentLedgerPack](https://rentledger.shihaoeth.site/)

## MotionPack camera control

- [MotionPack](https://motionpack.shihaoeth.site/) generates photo-guided videos using Seedance 2.5 Pro, Seedance 2.0 Fast, and Seedream 5.0 Pro.
- [Camera control studio](https://motionpack.shihaoeth.site/ai-camera-control-video-generator) draws and previews a path over a source photo.
- [Real estate drone flythrough generator](https://motionpack.shihaoeth.site/tools/real-estate-drone-flythrough-generator) renders a start, curve, and target as a Catmull–Rom trajectory plate for a single AI-generated HD shot.
- [Storefront and hotel FPV tour maker](https://motionpack.shihaoeth.site/tools/storefront-and-hotel-fpv-tour-maker) uses a drawn FPV or gimbal path for an entrance approach and removes red guide marks from the generated video.
- [Copy camera motion from a reference video](https://motionpack.shihaoeth.site/tools/copy-camera-motion-from-reference-video) borrows camera movement from a curated clip and anchors appearance to one or two product photos.
- [AI product video generator from a photo](https://motionpack.shihaoeth.site/tools/ai-product-video-generator-from-photo) stages a 2K scene and generates a five- or ten-second ad with native English lip-sync.
